beats: A trading bot needs eight jobs done — watch the market, score risk, decide, trade, and guard the money.
Do that with eight separate timers and they trip over each other's numbers.
Now one Durable Object owns the whole loop.
Instead of eight cooks fighting over one stove, it's one cook working a single ticket at a time.
Every 30 seconds it walks the whole desk in order — no server to babysit, no race. Eight schedules became one.
